feeding_claim.verbatim: Throughout their lives our animals have access to high quality grass and hay, mineral and salt.

pickup_locations: Local locker (custom beef and whole lamb)
Iowa Food Hub drop locations such as Cedar Falls, Cedar Rapids and Des Moines (custom orders, fee billed by Iowa Food Hub)

availability.note: Custom quarter and half beef sold out for 2026 with a waitlist; retail beef and lamb cuts sold at the farm store.

notes: Checked homepage, beef, lamb and farm store pages. Beef is 100% grass fed on pasture and farm-grown hay with no grain mentioned; lamb page says lambs are never fed grain. Farm store open Fridays 4 to 8 during pizza nights. Custom quarter or half beef and whole lamb are picked up at the locker or delivered through Iowa Food Hub drop sites.
